design.stage: EAB round 5, step 2: verification-cost ladder with source-disjoint image clients
design.question: Does the CIFAR verification ladder, and the private gain it certifies, survive when no private source image is reused across or within clients?
design.prior_knowledge_disclosed: Designers know the reused-source CIFAR-1k ladder (tab-verify-ladder) and its 26.6-point eps=1 gain-policy improvement over the public fallback.
design.partition: sequential: each client draws Dirichlet(alpha=.1) class proportions and 40 labels; images are taken WITHOUT replacement from per-class pools of the 45000 private images (renormalizing over non-exhausted classes); the first 32 are training, the last 8 held-out; 40000 images used, each exactly once; client seed = cohort seed
design.composition: sequential, one total budget per deployment

teacher.model: linear softmax head on frozen 128-d DINOv2 features

design.naming: K=C/M; one protected aggregate at rho fraction .5 (as release-value private_validation)
design.candidate_family: as release-value private_validation.select: public count match, eight joint weights, private centered and coverage; exact LOO on the 10 labels
design.label_draws: release-value-20261019/public/labels_{0..99}.json (the same 100 ten-label draws as the reused-source demonstration)

validation.gain_report: per-client held-out accuracy difference, s=2^16, integer sensitivity s
validation.class_report: C x 4 joint correctness histogram per client, normalized by its 8 records, squared sensitivity 2 s^2
validation.bands: gain lower and direct linear-sum class bands of release-value-20261019; non-degradation band of release-eab-20261020/thresholds.py; alpha=.025

primary.S1: at eps=1, the gain-verified policy has unconditional test accuracy above the public fallback with crossed-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 (cohorts x draws, 2000 replicates, seed 20261025)
primary.reported_against: the reused-source ladder at the same eps (paired label draws, different cohorts)

predictions: acceptance is monotone along the ladder at every eps (gain>0 >= gain>=.10 >= gain>=.20; recalls>0 >= >=.25 >= >=.50; eta=.50 >= eta=.25)
no false accept at eps >= 1 for any ladder rule
the eps=1 gain-policy improvement over the public fallback is smaller than in the reused-source demonstration (fewer training records per client)
design.confound_disclosed: source-disjointness at n=1000 forces 32 training records per client instead of 480; the contrast mixes source reuse with per-client data size

reporting.test_labels: loaded only after all protected decisions
reporting.amendments: implementation fixes after this freeze are logged in AMENDMENTS.json with time and reason
